/.title: Vyom Gor :: Embedded Software Engineer, Bengaluru
/.description: Vyom Gor is an embedded software engineer in Bengaluru writing C and C++ close to the hardware: ARM7, CAN bus, I2C and Linux system programming.

/about.title: About :: Vyom Gor, Embedded Software Engineer
/about.description: From Kutch to Bengaluru: how Vyom Gor went from a diploma and a 9.08 CGPA B.Tech to embedded Linux work at VVDN Technologies.

/lab.title: Lab :: Interactive embedded experiments
/lab.description: Browser experiments from an embedded engineer: a CAN bus simulator, an HD44780 glyph studio, a logic analyzer, a register flipper and a C shell.

/writing.title: Writing :: Notes on embedded C, CAN and Linux
/writing.description: Posts by Vyom Gor on embedded C, the CAN bus on the LPC2129, interrupts and volatile, pointers, and writing a Unix shell in C.

/bench.title: Bench :: Experience and skills of Vyom Gor
/bench.description: Experience, education, certificates and skills: VVDN Technologies, Vector India, ARM7 LPC2129, CAN 2.0B, I2C, SPI, UART, POSIX threads and systemd.

/contact.title: Contact :: Write to Vyom Gor
/contact.description: Write a letter to Vyom Gor about embedded software roles, collaborations or just to say hello, or book a 15-minute call.

/resume.title: Resume :: Vyom Gor, Embedded Software Engineer
/resume.description: Web resume of Vyom Gor: embedded C and C++, ARM7 LPC2129, CAN bus, I2C, SPI, UART and Linux system programming. Printable as a PDF.

/now.title: Now :: What Vyom Gor is working on
/now.description: What Vyom Gor is building and learning right now in embedded Linux and C++, and what comes next.

/notes.title: Notes :: Today I learned in C, ARM7 and Linux
/notes.description: Short notes from the bench: volatile and ISRs, IOSET and IOCLR, CAN bit stuffing, HD44780 CGRAM, fork, strtok, getline and more.

/changelog.title: Changelog :: What's new on Vyom Gor's site
/changelog.description: Everything new on the site, newest first: posts, lab experiments, work milestones and site updates.

/lab/can-bus.title: CAN Bus Lab :: LPC2129 CAN simulator
/lab/can-bus.description: Drive a two-node CAN 2.0B network in the browser: flip switches on an LPC2129, watch frame 0x500 with CRC-15 and bit stuffing land on a 16x2 LCD.

/lab/glyph-studio.title: Glyph Studio :: HD44780 custom character maker
/lab/glyph-studio.description: Draw 5x8 custom characters for an HD44780 16x2 LCD and copy the CGRAM byte array straight into your C code.

/lab/logic-analyzer.title: Logic Analyzer :: UART, I2C and SPI decoder
/lab/logic-analyzer.description: Type a byte and see it on the wire as UART, I2C or SPI waveforms, with every bit decoded. A browser logic analyzer for learning serial buses.

/lab/register-flipper.title: Register Flipper :: LPC2129 GPIO register tool
/lab/register-flipper.description: Flip LPC2129 port bits and get the IODIR, IOSET and IOCLR values and C lines for free. An interactive ARM7 GPIO register playground.

/lab/led-matrix.title: LED Matrix :: Spring physics in the browser
/lab/led-matrix.description: A grid of LEDs on one spring integration, pushed around by your cursor. Tune stiffness, damping, radius and force.

/lab/shell.title: imperfect_cell :: A Unix shell in C, in the browser
/lab/shell.description: Try imperfect_cell, Vyom Gor's Unix-like shell written in C with fork, execvp and wait, rebuilt to run in the browser. Type help to start.

/board.title: Board :: Drive this site from a CAN board
/board.description: Drive Vyom Gor's portfolio from his 3D CAN dashboard board: flip the DIP switches to pick a page, turn the knob, press SEND and watch the LCD.

/work.title: Work :: Projects by Vyom Gor
/work.description: The Memory Vault: every project Vyom Gor has built, from a two-node CAN dashboard on ARM7 to a Unix shell in C, with what each one does.

/machine.title: Machine :: Skills and lab toys of Vyom Gor
/machine.description: C, Linux, embedded systems, systemd, networking, Git and debugging, plus interactive lab toys you can try right in the browser.
